summary: Add tsconfig.build.json + build scripts + cli.ts tsImport loader so dist/cli.js can load chain.ts per §4.

new.description: Per §4: extend tsconfig.json; noEmit:false, outDir:./dist, declaration+map+sourceMap, drop allowImportingTsExtensions.

edit.description: Add scripts.build=tsc -p tsconfig.build.json and scripts.prepublishOnly=pnpm build.
Replace the chain.ts `await import(...)` with `tsImport()` from tsx/esm/api — see §4 loader contract.

acceptance: pnpm build emits dist/index.js + dist/index.d.ts + dist/cli.js; `node dist/cli.js status` loads .flume/chain.ts without a node loader flag.
notes: cli.ts loader is bundled here because dist is only useful once dist/cli.js can resolve chain.ts; bin/flume flip is the separate, downstream BIN-FLUME-DIST entry.

summary: Flip package.json to publish-ready: version 0.1.0, private:false, license, repository/homepage/bugs, keywords, main/types/exports, files allowlist.

edit.description: All §4 'package.json must have' bullets + §2 exports map. tsx stays in dependencies per §4 (loader contract).

acceptance: npm pack --dry-run shows only files in §8 allowlist; npx @arethetypeswrong/cli --pack . is clean.
notes: Scope name (e.g. @<github-username>/flume) is publish-time per §4; commit lands a placeholder + CHANGELOG note at tag.

summary: Flip bin/flume from tsx-based shim to `exec node $DIR/../dist/cli.js` per §4.

edit.description: Per §4: plain `exec node "$DIR/../dist/cli.js"`; cli.ts already carries the tsImport loader.

acceptance: Installed-as-dependency `npx flume status` runs against dist/.

summary: Add stage-marker logs to runFanout: cherry-pick lines, ship-commit summary, cleanup count, wave duration.

edit.description: Per inbox finding: ~15-20 LOC in `runFanout`. `[flume]` prefix matches existing fanout-pickable line. No per-stage durations, no CLI override (pre-resolved).

acceptance: Successful fanout wave logs a cherry-pick line per shipped entry, the ship-commit summary, cleanup count, and total wave time. Failure paths unchanged.
notes: §3 is the closest spec home (operator-facing surface). Reviewer pre-scoped: stage markers + wave duration only; no per-stage timings; no log-override knob. Severity: low correctness, high ergonomics.
